svg.title: Pocket AI wiring schematic: Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3
svg.desc: Exact GPIO schematic. TFT CS1 DC2 RESET3 SCK7 MOSI9. Button4 to ground. Microphone and amplifier share BCLK5 and WS6. Microphone SD43 and L/R ground. Amplifier DIN44, VIN switched battery. Speaker only between SPK+ and SPK-. LiPo positive through switch common and ON contact to XIAO BAT+ and amplifier VIN. LiPo negative, XIAO BAT-, and all grounds are common. XIAO 3V3 powers TFT VCC/BL and microphone. GPIO8 reserved. Equal power net labels represent an electrical connection.
svg.text: Original Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3 • ST7789 • INMP441 • MAX98357A
To XIAO BAT+ and amplifier VIN
BAT− and all GND pins share common ground
Equal power net labels are connected. Junction dots connect; crossing humps do not.
TFT VCC / BL and microphone VCC use 3V3. INMP441 L/R goes to GND. Never ground a speaker lead.
First USB test: battery switch OFF, amplifier VIN disconnected. USB charging can energize the BAT node.
Module-level schematic • Pin order is logical; use the actual pad labels • Exact firmware GPIO mapping
